outcome: type of delivery (normal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 30 primi mothers in their second trimester of pregnancy, with 15 in an experimental group and 15 in a control group.
finding: Antenatal exercises and yoga were found to be effective interventions for promoting normal vaginal deliveries, increasing comfort, and reducing labor pain intensity among primi antenatal mothers.
mod_finding: The experimental group had a higher percentage of normal vaginal deliveries (40%) compared to the control group (20%), and the majority of mothers in the experimental group experienced normal vaginal delivery.
